result:
The fix is commit `f462a28` (PR #376, ticket O3-5993, "Reports app shows literal {parameters} instead of the missing parameter names"). The bug was a single-brace placeholder: `{parameters}` is not interpolated by i18next, which expects `{{parameters}}`. The commit changes the placeholder to `{{parameters}}` in both the component's `t()` default string and the English translation file. The commit also reverts the non-English translation files, which Transifex manages, so those locales pick up the corrected placeholder on their next sync.

The implementing line is `openmrs-esm-admin-tools/packages/esm-reports-app/src/components/reports-data-overview.component.tsx:77`, where `t('missingParameters', 'Please provide the following parameters: {{parameters}}', ...)` builds the snackbar subtitle. The commit also adds a test file that checks the subtitle names the missing required parameters.

Evidence, best first:
- Fix commit `f462a28` (PR #376): the diff changes `{parameters}` to `{{parameters}}` in the component and in `en.json`.
- `openmrs-esm-admin-tools/packages/esm-reports-app/src/components/reports-data-overview.component.tsx:77`: the line that now uses the correct placeholder (confirmed at the fix commit).
- `openmrs-esm-admin-tools/packages/esm-reports-app/translations/en.json:34`: the English string with the corrected placeholder.
- `openmrs-esm-admin-tools/packages/esm-reports-app/src/components/reports-data-overview.component.test.tsx:1-104`: new tests asserting the subtitle lists the missing parameter labels.
